name: circle-wave
title: Circle Wave
description: A waveform wrapped around a ring on canvas, seamless all the way round. Radial bars, stacked meter segments, layered echo lines or a solid fill, growing out, in or both ways. Bloom, interference, spectrum, voice, blob and pulse patterns, a custom wave(angle, t) or a controlled value; sweep, tip or level gradients with ready-made palettes; glow, spin, a hover bump and centered children.
